question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

To beat the clock

options.text: To be very angry for being late
To perform a task within the time limit

solution:
The correct answer is **To perform a task within the time limit. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom **"To beat the clock" **is** "To perform a task within the time limit."**
 
• **To beat the clock** refers to completing something swiftly before a deadline.
 
 
• ​**Example:*** He beat the clock when he submitted his assignment. *
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is** To perform a task within the time limit.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
